subject.title: Bug: Gateway falsely marks healthy local vLLM endpoints as timed out/overloaded, causing 1–23 min fallback cascades

question: Should this issue remain the canonical P1 live-repro item for the unresolved healthy-vLLM false-timeout and gateway RPC latency cascade, or should maintainers narrow it now to a specific timeout/fallback policy surface?
rationale: The current code proves multiple adjacent fixes, but only a maintainer-controlled live trace can decide whether the remaining behavior is a runtime bug, config/docs guidance, or an already-fixed stale report.

options.title: Keep as live-repro root

options.title: Narrow to config or docs
